data.name: 5.25-inch dual-format floppy mechanism
requirements: Period sourcing selection: SA400 35-track single-sided mechanism; Aurelia uses FM single density. Freeze formatted sector geometry; do not imply 360 KB capacity.

SA400-derived OEM mechanism with Logix dual-format electronics. Stock SA400 electronics are not asserted to support Apple II GCR; qualify raw read/write timing, GCR/FM switching and media interchange. Existing mechanism and controller BOM elements stay intact.
Historical availability: Shugart November 1977 SA400/SA450 application bulletin; model selection does not resolve electrical, mechanical or supply qualification.
